'''2010 ATL Cube Draft''' was a ten-player [[Cube|cube draft]] event held on 23 January 2010. Graham won, and the tournament report's author, Throdo, finished second.<ref name="report">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=33296#p505059 ATL CUBE DRAFT 1/23/10], Throdo, Players Committee Forums (24 January 2010).</ref>

== Draft and deck construction ==

The event used cubes assembled by Throdo and [[Kevin Reitzel]]. Each participant drafted both Light Side and Dark Side cards. The report describes 45-card decks: players drafted 45 cards, added 12 fixed locations, and then removed 12 cards to complete each deck.<ref name="report" />
